Why Choose KSV Solutions Ltd

From the first call through to servicing, you are kept informed and everything is explained as we go. Every job is quoted to what you need and what you want to spend.

  • Communication First

    You are kept up to date at every stage, from the first call to the finished job.

  • Established Brands

    Cameras and alarms from makers such as Hikvision, the kit you can see in our photos.

  • Bespoke Quotes

    Every system is specified for your property, your needs and your budget.

  • Shown How It Works

    Before we leave, we take you through your cameras, alarm or smart controls.

  • Local to Solihull

    Based in Solihull, covering the West Midlands and Warwickshire, and further afield for bespoke work.

About Us

The Team Behind KSV Solutions Ltd
